semantics.seen: Distinct target IDs retained in result, request or funnel records, including stale targets.
semantics.on_topic: Passed topic checks in that original run; the new map is never backdated.
semantics.above_floor: Recorded ranking acceptance; legacy absent scores stay unobserved.
semantics.authored: Writer returned a draft; validated counts separately represent pack checks.
semantics.sent: Bot API confirmation in the original run; a public reply or phone read is not inferred.
semantics.timings: Measured stage duration, not invented candidate latency. Zero sends gives no delivery latency.
